angle: Northbridge lead 1-0 at half after a late Chaos spike; Malo Ferrand has been a catalyst with high xT contribution and risky passing under pressure.

explanation.why_it_matters: Malo Ferrand’s high-risk passing (avg difficulty 40.4, dva -0.128) generated 0.457 xT and sparked a late Chaos spike that moved the half from control into contested play. That shift let Northbridge protect a 1-0 lead despite rising turnovers (z 0.47) and chaos 67 with control_share 0.55.

en.headline: Half-time: Northbridge lead
en.body: Northbridge go in 1-0 up after a frantic finish to the half. Malo Ferrand has been key, driving danger with risky passing and good attacking intent.

it.headline: Intervallo: Northbridge in vantaggio
it.body: Northbridge vanno all'intervallo sull'1-0 dopo un finale di tempo frenetico. Malo Ferrand è stato determinante, creando pericolo con passaggi rischiosi e buona voglia di attaccare.

es.headline: Descanso: Northbridge arriba
es.body: Northbridge se va al descanso 1-0 tras un final de primera parte frenético. Malo Ferrand ha sido clave, creando peligro con pases arriesgados y claro espíritu ofensivo.

ja.headline: ハーフタイム：Northbridgeがリード
ja.body: Northbridgeは前半の最後の慌ただしい場面を制し1-0で折り返します。Malo Ferrandが鍵で、リスクの高いパスと力強い攻撃意図で脅威を作っています。

en.headline: Chaos spike shifts half
en.body: Chaos 67; NBR xG 0.7; possession 0.621; Malo Ferrand xT 0.457 and avg_pass_difficulty 40.4 with DVA -0.128. Late tremors and risky passing explain the contested state into half-time.

it.headline: Picco di caos cambia il primo tempo
it.body: Chaos 67; NBR xG 0.7; possesso 0.621; Malo Ferrand xT 0.457 e avg_pass_difficulty 40.4 con DVA -0.128. I tremori finali e i passaggi rischiosi spiegano lo stato contestato all'intervallo.

es.headline: Pico de caos cambia la mitad
es.body: Chaos 67; NBR xG 0.7; posesión 0.621; Malo Ferrand xT 0.457 y avg_pass_difficulty 40.4 con DVA -0.128. Los temblores finales y los pases riesgosos explican el estado disputado al llegar al descanso.

ja.headline: Chaos spike shifts half
ja.body: Chaos 67; NBR xG 0.7; ボール支配率 0.621; Malo Ferrand xT 0.457 と avg_pass_difficulty 40.4、DVA -0.128。終了間際の揺れとリスクの高いパスが前半の拮抗した状況を説明します。

en.headline: Half-time update: Northbridge lead
en.body: On the left wing, Malo Ferrand repeatedly plays high-risk passes that create threat. Northbridge keep a 1-0 lead at half. The game ended the half in a contested, chaotic spell.

it.headline: Aggiornamento all'intervallo: Northbridge in vantaggio
it.body: Sulla fascia sinistra, Malo Ferrand gioca ripetutamente passaggi ad alto rischio che generano pericolo. Northbridge mantiene l'1-0 all'intervallo. La partita ha concluso il primo tempo in una fase contestata e caotica.

es.headline: Actualización al descanso: Northbridge arriba
es.body: Por la banda izquierda, Malo Ferrand juega repetidamente pases de alto riesgo que generan amenaza. Northbridge mantiene la ventaja de 1-0 en el descanso. El partido terminó la primera parte en un período contendido y caótico.

ja.headline: ハーフタイム更新：Northbridgeがリード
ja.body: 左サイドでMalo Ferrandが繰り返しハイリスクのパスを通し、攻撃の脅威を作っています。Northbridgeは前半を1-0でリードして折り返します。前半は終了直前に揉めるような混戦の場面で終わりました。

en.headline: Ferrand’s daring half
en.body: Malo Ferrand ran the left, touching the ball 37 times and adding 0.457 xT. His high average pass difficulty (40.4) and risky choices (DVA -0.128) sparked the late chaos that helped protect the 1-0 lead.

it.headline: La mezza audace di Ferrand
it.body: Malo Ferrand ha corso sulla sinistra, toccando il pallone 37 volte e contribuendo 0.457 xT. La sua alta avg_pass_difficulty (40.4) e le scelte rischiose (DVA -0.128) hanno innescato il caos finale che ha aiutato a proteggere l'1-0.

es.headline: La audacia de Ferrand en la primera parte
es.body: Malo Ferrand jugó en la izquierda, tocando el balón 37 veces y sumando 0.457 xT. Su alta avg_pass_difficulty (40.4) y las decisiones arriesgadas (DVA -0.128) provocaron el caos final que ayudó a preservar el 1-0.

ja.headline: Ferrandの大胆な前半
ja.body: Malo Ferrandは左を駆け、ボールに37回触れ、0.457のxTを記録しました。平均パス難度が40.4で、リスキーな選択（DVA -0.128）が後半終了間際の混乱を生み、1-0のリードを守るのに貢献しました。
